label: Slovakia2016: 19 numbered botanical sampling units, named invasive contributions, and confounded geography/elevation
original_source_author: Májeková & Limánek (2016) Bulletin Slovenskej botanickej spoločnosti 38:37–45

sampling.source_unit_definition_reference: Original PDF printed p38; two close station/stop pairs pooled

source_geo.caution_basis: r=0.9924, adjusted coefficient sign changes, and whole-unit deletion instability; not a cond>30 threshold exceedance

source_tests.chain_start_state: same observed incidence matrix for both chains; different PRNG seeds

inference_limits: The 15th reported invasive taxon was not publicly named in the author's explicit list; NOT invented.
The 14 observed named invasive taxa are not all 98 alien taxa.
Local species sharing contribution is calculated with ALL plant taxa Jaccard denominator, NOT invasive-only Jaccard.
Distance and elevation are confounded (r=+0.9924) and cannot identify causal geography or altitude selection.
19 stations are all on one Poprad river valley rail line, not 19 independent study replications.
2×199 MCMC draws correlated; ranks are technical relative to fixed margins, NOT ecological randomized field p values.
No actual 2012-14 train traffic, seed carriage, mowing, local nonrail vegetation or railway vs road experiment.
Does NOT replicate Slovenian 2020 freight vs local/intra-line opposite slopes or Májeková 2025 30-station freight richness.
19 numbered botanical sampling units pool two pairs among 21 physical stations/stops; representative source coordinates do not unpool their floras.
The two group contributions are additive responses with a common denominator, not statistically independent groups.
398 technical draws are collected separately for each of two null modes; both seeded chains start at the observed matrix.
Central technical ranks do not establish equivalence or absence of an ecological effect.
The altitude-tertile reference also conditions on spatial position and the source phytogeographic district boundary.

response_definition.denominator: all-taxa union for each pair of numbered sampling units
response_definition.group_contributions: shared named invasive taxa / all-taxa union + shared other taxa / same union = full Jaccard
